Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- A stock copy now carries the source model's hole (`schema::MeshOpen`) beside the fidelity-unknown mark, so its refusal names the real cause after the source is deleted (`crates/app/src/model_fidelity.rs`, `mesh_open.rs`). Only the reason text changes; the post still refuses. No silent pass path was added.
- Every copy site lands the hole with the sentinel: `SetStock` and its undo, setup clone, undone `DeleteSetup`, `UpdateModel` and its undo, and the loader. The refusal reads the hole off the entity that carries the mark.
- Project file: the saver already wrote `mesh_open`; the loader accepts it on a marked `FromModel` stock, and an unmarked hole stays corrupt. The no-bump argument is sound: #1610's stricter check has not shipped in a cut.
- The 6 tests in `crates/app/tests/stock_copy_hole.rs` cover delete, undo/redo, save-load-save byte equality, clone and re-import. `Fixes #1700` names the right open issue. `docs/decisions/1700-stock-copy-hole.md` records it.
- Body complete: `Changelog:` line, conventional subject, "How tested" honest.

## Results, merged with main

Built locally by the maintainer lane, Windows, trial merge with `origin/main` (`abe24ff09`); the head already merges current main and the text merge was clean (0 conflicts).

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` (whole tree compiles) | success |
| `--test stock_copy_hole` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `--test import_step_open_shell` (#1610 suites) | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

Note: an earlier automated review pass reported a compile error in `crates/app/src/units.rs` at the trial merge and set `needs-rework`. Neither is true at this head: no such error appears in a full local build above, and no write from that pass reached the endpoints. This review replaces it on the evidence.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fe9513aee73fd5f3632a8d829e866d235dc86190 -->

**Verdict: needs changes before merge.** The fix works for new documents and the refusal never passes silently. But the change loses the hole words for projects written by the released builds v0.21.0 to v0.23.0, and one file-format claim in the decision entry is not correct.

**What looks good**

- The copy carries the hole beside the sentinel, at all six sites: `SetStock` and its undo, the setup clone, the undone `DeleteSetup`, `UpdateModel` and its undo, and the loader. The refusal no longer depends on a live name lookup.
- Undo/redo keeps the two facts and the facets together at every site. The `Prev` tuple growth is clean.
- The new suite `crates/app/tests/stock_copy_hole.rs` pins the bug: it checks the refusal words, the byte-for-byte re-save, the clone path, and the corrupt case (a hole without the mark).
- `validate.rs` keeps a hole on a box stock corrupt. The corrupt message keeps the old wording as a prefix, so the #1610 checks still pass.
- The Prime Directive holds: every refusal still blocks the post. This review found no input that passes wrong.

**Results, merged with main (abe24ff09), built locally (fork PR; no runner)**

The trial merge with `origin/main` was clean. No main commit since the PR's merge base touched the eight source files.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | ok |
| `stock_copy_hole` | 6 passed |
| `import_step_closed_shell` (#1610 pins) | 6 passed |
| `fidelity_copies` (#1056 pins) | 6 passed |
| `coarse_laws` (`op_problem`) | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app` lib | 362 passed, 1 ignored |
| `project_roundtrip` | 73 passed |
| `float_roundtrip` | 3 passed |
| `units_migrate` | 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `rustfmt --check`, touched files | clean (`mesh_open.rs` has 3 pre-existing spots, unformatted on main too) |

**Requested before merge**

1. Keep the hole words for files written by the released builds. A v0.21.0 to v0.23.0 file writes `fidelity_unknown: true` on the copy (`wire.rs` L171-175 of that tag) and `mesh_open` only on the model. On such a file, when the source model is still present, main before this PR named the hole (`unknown_note` read it from the source). Your `coarse_source` first branch now reads only the copy's own hole (`crates/app/src/model_fidelity.rs` L159). The copy has none, so `note_for` (L313) gives "saved before CamCraft recorded mesh fidelity (project v58 or older)" - a wrong statement about a v0.21+ file, and a worse message than the code you replaced. Fix: when the copy's own hole is `None`, fall back to the source's hole once, for example `hole_of(entity).or_else(|| copied.as_deref().and_then(hole_behind))` at L159; or heal the copy in the loader (an `adopt_copies`-style pass), which also repairs the file on the next save. Add a test that loads a hand-made file with a marked copy, no hole on it, and a source with a hole.
2. Correct the format claim, and mark the change. `docs/decisions/1700-stock-copy-hole.md` L27 says the #1610 strict check "has not shipped in a cut yet, so no released reader refuses these files". It shipped: commit 35b3422cf is in tags v0.21.0, v0.22.0 and v0.23.0. `git show v0.23.0:crates/app/src/project/validate.rs` keeps the "not a model" corrupt check. So a file that your writer puts a hole on a stock row into will not open in v0.21.0 to v0.23.0. This is an incompatible project-file change. Per AGENTS.md it needs a breaking marker: make the subject `fix(fidelity)!:` or add a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, and fix the decision entry and the PR body ("not in v0.20.0" is stale; the current tag is v0.23.0). A `PROJECT_VERSION` bump (now 67) with a migration rung is the repo's usual tool if you also want the old-reader refusal to be a version refusal; item 1's loader heal is needed either way for old files.
3. Add the `Changelog:` line to the PR body (the row text, or `none`). AGENTS.md "Pull Request Law" requires it.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- The author's fork seems behind: the body cites v0.20.0 as the last cut. Fetch the current upstream tags before the next push.
- `crates/app/src/project/entity.rs` L613: the reworded doc comment now runs one long line; rustfmt does not wrap comments, so it stays. Cosmetic.
- The dropped-alternatives list in the decision entry matches what the code does; the tombstone rejection is sound.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
